tools.description: Free up a site that has an inactive previous registration. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account · Private data: account, ad_settings, application_status, apply, checklist, integration, payments, reclaim, recover, reporting, subscriptions, video · Public sink: account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account · Private data: account, ad_settings, application_status, apply, checklist, integration, payments, reclaim, recover, reporting, subscriptions, video · Public sink: account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
